newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MATCHES IN THE FRENCH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCHES IN THE FRENCH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Programme of matches in the French first division this weekend (standings in parentheses, all kickoff times GMT)

Bastia, who won last three league games before winter recess, are still without Slovakian Lubomir Moravcik, not yet fit after breaking a leg in October. Marseille, short of match practice after their French Cup tie with Lille was controversially postponed, play without suspended striker Marc Libbra and Tunisian Mehdi Ben Slimane, on international duty.

Nantes aim to increase their unbeaten run in league to 17 matches after poor start to 1997 with elimination from both domestic cup competitions by lower division teams. Playmaker Japhet N'Doram, Argentine Javier Mazzoni and Yugoslav Nenad Bjekovic are al injured.

Bordeaux go into match against bottom team on high note after successive wins in both dometic cups and midfielder Ibrahima Ba back from sensational debut for France. Nice, under new coach Sylvester Takac, have long injury list.
Czech defender Jan Suchoparek needs cartilage operation and is out of Strasbourg side for at least three weeks. Rennes are still looking for first away win.
Metz, unbeaten in three games, will be without forward Amara Traore, on international duty with Senegal. Nancy, who have defender Paul Fischer suspended, have not won at home since early November.

Cannes coach Guy Lacombe is struggling to find fit side with eight players injured and four suspended. Newly signed former France international Philippe Vercruysse has helped Lens stay on course in both domestic cups, but Czech striker Vladimir Smicer is doubtful after breaking nose in traning.

Postponed French Cup tie against Marseille has left Lille without match practice since they drew 1-1 at Nice in league on December 20. Lille, only team to win at Guingamp last season, are without suspended midfielder Roger Hitoto. Home side have striker Christopher Wreh absent with Liberia national team.
Gregory Coupet makes his Lyon debut in goal following sacking of Pascal Olmeta. Montpellier have two players suspended and Ibrahim Bakayoko on international duty with Ivory Coast.

Crucial clash between title aspirants which could leave PSG, who have won only one of last six league games, seven points adrift if they lose. Each deprived of one injured defender, Alain Roche of PSG and Monaco's Belgian Philippe Leonard.

The champions will be without Algerian internationals Moussa Saib and Abdel Tasfaout, on international duty, but defender Alain Goma returns from injury. Caen put four goals past Le Havre in their last home game.
